decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - No works to demolish the listed buildings shall start without prior written notification of the start to English Heritage with a copy to the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall not be carried out otherwise than in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority (or as shall have otherwise been agreed in advance and in writing by the Local Planning Authority) before Wallis House is occupied.  Any applications for variation shall be accompanied, inter alia, by overlay drawings provided by the applicant for comparison with the permitted scheme.
Condition : 4 - All works of making good, shall match the original work in type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 5 - A schedule (including reasoned justification) of repairs and works to the external fabric of Wallis House, the interior areas highlighted in the submitted drawings (A1677 1216 P1 and A1677 1217 P1)  and all repairs and works to the Grade II listed railings facing the Great West Road shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of works. The schedule shall include detailed design of connections/linkages to original fabric and detailed design of adaptations/additions where these affect the appearance and/or character of the listed buildings.Any part of the listed buildings consented to be demolished or hidden by new work shall be recorded photographically and an archive noting locations kept; a copy of the annotated archive shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority (with a copy for the Twentieth Century Society) in accordance with a timetable to be agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.  Supporting note: A log book describing detailed work to the listed buildings should be provided to the managing agent for a permanent base record and as reference material for any future work, such as management agreements.

Condition : 6 - Sample panels of the materials and cleaning methods to be used in the external surfaces of Wallis House shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any works commence.  The sample panel shall be retained on site until the works to the building are completed in accordance with the approved detail.

Condition : 7 - The extensions to Wallis House to which demolition consent is hereby granted shall not be demolished before a contract for the carrying out of the work of redevelopment of the site has been let.

Condition : 8 - It is considered that the proposal would not unduly harm the special architectural and historic character of the listed buildings, subject to the work being carried out with care and attention to detail, in accordance with the specification described by the applicant and subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions. The proposal accords with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character) of the Hounslow UDP.
description: Alteration (including limited, selective demolition) of Wallis House in association with the re-instatement of employment use, the creation of a gallery, the provision of a health club and the introduction of residential use of the building.
